headlines.text: 2024 brought us this moment: it was title-change night for the AEW TNT Title as Adam Copeland vs. Christian Cage battled it out in an I Quit match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.10 ? a genuinely great match ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses. Christian Cage was chasing gold for the 10th time. In the third and most brutal chapter of their trilogy, Copeland won an I Quit match filled with hockey jerseys, ladders and handcuffs, finishing Christian Cage with a low blow and a shot from his barbed-wire weapon Spike to win the TNT Championship.

That Wednesday in 2024, it was title-change night for the AEW Continental Title as Kazuchika Okada vs. Eddie Kingston battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.68 ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. Okada shocked the world in his first singles match since signing, tricking Kingston with an eye rake before nailing the Rainmaker to win the AEW Continental Championship in his AEW debut.
Back on this day in 2024, Thunder Rosa was back in action after just under 2 months away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2024, Hook vs. Chris Jericho locked horns for the first time on Dynamite, rated 4.44.
